Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message is published when a new visible order has been received and added to the book.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Time Reference second.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to this order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The order price. Use with the Price Scale from the symbol-mapping index.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The order quantity in shares

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the order (Buy/Sell).

Field.Name: FirmID
Field.Description: The market participant's firm ID.

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Defaulted to 0. Future use only.

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: A Modify Order message is sent when the price or volume of an order is changed.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Time Reference second.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to the order to be modified

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new order price. Use the Price scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The new order quantity in shares.

Field.Name: PositionChange
Field.Description: Currently defaulted to 0.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the order.

Field.Name: Reserved 2
Field.Description: Defaulted to 0. Future use only.

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: A Delete Order message is published when an order is taken off of the book.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Time Reference second.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to the existing order to be deleted

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Defaulted to 0. Future use only.

Message.Name: Order Execution Message
Message.Description: An Order Execution message is sent when an order is partially or fully executed.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Time Reference second.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to the partially or fully executed order.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by the matching engine to this execution.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of this trade. Use the Price Scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The executed quantity in shares.

Field.Name: PrintableFlag
Field.Description: 0 = Not Printed to the SIP. 1 = Printed to the SIP.

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Defaulted to 0. Future use only.

Field.Name: TradeCond1
Field.Description: Settlement related conditions.

Field.Name: TradeCond2
Field.Description: The reason for Trade Through Exemptions.

Field.Name: TradeCond3
Field.Description: Extended hours/sequencing related conditions.

Field.Name: TradeCond4
Field.Description: SRO Required Detail.

Message.Name: Replace Order Message
Message.Description: A Replace Order message is published when a cancel/replace order is received and executed.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Time Reference second.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to the existing order to be replaced

Field.Name: NewOrderID
Field.Description: The new Order ID of the replacement order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new order price. Use the Price scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The new order quantity in shares.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: Reserved 2
Field.Description: Defaulted to 0. Future use only.

Message.Name: Imbalance Message
Message.Description: Imbalance messages are published once a second during auctions to update price and volume information.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in secs since 1/1/1970 00:00:00 UTC

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Source Time

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol

Field.Name: ReferencePrice
Field.Description: The price at which imbalances are calculated.

Field.Name: PairedQty
Field.Description: Number of shares paired at the Reference Price.

Field.Name: TotalImbalanceQty
Field.Description: The total imbalance quantity at the Reference Price.

Field.Name: MarketImbalanceQty
Field.Description: The total market order imbalance quantity at the Reference Price.

Field.Name: AuctionTime
Field.Description: Projected Auction Time (hhmm)

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: Auction type indicator.

Field.Name: ImbalanceSide
Field.Description: The side of the TotalImbalanceQty

Field.Name: ContinuousBookClearingPrice
Field.Description: The price closest to the reference price where the imbalance is 0.

Field.Name: AuctionInterestClearingPrice
Field.Description: The price at which auction only interest would trade.

Field.Name: SSRFilingPrice
Field.Description: For NYSE non-Significant imbalances, if a Sell Short Restriction is in effect, the price at which Sell Short interest will be filed.

Field.Name: IndicativeMatchPrice
Field.Description: The best price at which the maximum volume of shares is executable in the applicable auction, subject to Auction Collars.

Field.Name: UpperCollar
Field.Description: Upper boundary for the Indicative Match Price.

Field.Name: LowerCollar
Field.Description: Lower boundary for the Indicative Match Price.

Field.Name: AuctionStatus
Field.Description: Indicates whether the auction will run.

Field.Name: FreezeStatus
Field.Description: Indicates an Imbalance Freeze for the auction.

Field.Name: NumExtensions
Field.Description: The number of times a halt period has been extended

Field.Name: Unpaired Qty
Field.Description: The number of unpaired shares priced at or better than the Reference Price.

Field.Name: Unpaired Side
Field.Description: The side of the Unpaired Qty

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Add Order Refresh Message
Message.Description: The Add Order Refresh message can be sent in either of two contexts: refresh response or symbol refresh.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: The unique ID assigned by the matching engine to this order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The order price. Use the Price scale from the symbol-mapping index.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The order quantity in shares.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of the order (Buy/sell).

Field.Name: FirmID
Field.Description: The participant's firm ID, or blanks if firm ID was not specified OR if the order is not marked as attributed.

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Defaulted to 0. Future use only.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Message
Message.Description: In the event that an earlier trade has been reported in error, a Trade Cancel message is sent.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: The TradeID of the original Trade or Execution message to be cancelled.

Message.Name: Cross Correction Message
Message.Description: In the event that an earlier Cross Trade has been reported in error, a Cross Correction message is sent.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index msg

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message in the set of all messages for this symbol

Field.Name: CrossID
Field.Description: The CrossID of the original Cross Trade message to be corrected.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The corrected volume of Cross Trade message.
